course_description: Deals with a practical hands-on introduction in Web Development with the help of the latest version of Notepad++ editor/NetBeans IDE2008, Microsoft Internet Explorer browser, and Microsoft Visual Web Developer Express Edition Integrated Development Environment necessary to implement web-based application; and introduces program server-side web pages using PHP and MySQL.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand and apply the concepts involving frameworks for website development.
Create codes written in PHP and various web site development tools.
Analyze different structures and designs in creating website.
Demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Study what is PHP, common Uses, characteristics and syntax of PHP and how to apply it for website development.
Learn about Types of Variables, Constants and Operator Types in PHP and its application on creating a web page.
Learn about Decision-Making Statements in PHP and its implementation on developing web pages.

additional_text: Collaboration, Skilled Communication, Knowledge Construction, Self-Regulation, Real-World Problem-Solving.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand and apply the concepts involving frameworks for website development.
Create codes written in PHP and various web site development tools.
Evaluate design standards in planning layout, design and development of a complete website.
Develop and apply web development concepts that are competitive in technological areas.
Demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Learn about the different Iterative Statements in PHP and how to use them on a web page development setup.
Learn the use of Arrays in PHP and its application on web page development.
Learn PHP Web Concepts and MySQL.
